title: Mid-term evaluation of the Northern Ireland Rural Development Programme (NIRDP) 2007-2013
file_title: Mid term evaluation of the Northern Ireland Rural Development Programme 2007 - 2013 Adobe PDF (3.02 MB)
description: This document describes a mid-term evaluation of the Northern Ireland Rural Development Programme (NIRDP) for the period 2007-2013, which aims to support rural areas through various measures. The evaluation, adhering to the European Evaluation Network for Rural Development's Guidelines, utilized a comprehensive methodological approach including desk research, fieldwork, and interviews to assess the program's strategy, effectiveness, and impact. Despite progress and positive feedback on certain aspects, challenges such as funding difficulties, economic downturns, and low expenditure in some areas were identified. The NIRDP has had varied success in meeting its goals, with some measures being oversubscribed and others underperforming. Financial challenges were exacerbated by the economic climate and uncertainties in national funding. The program's reach across Northern Ireland was noted, though improvements are recommended in application processing, financial management, and engagement of target groups like women and young people. The evaluation underscores the need for immediate action to enhance the NIRDP's effectiveness and efficiency in revitalizing rural Northern Ireland.
